description: County/Hospital Alert Tracking System (CHATS) - Maryland Institute for Emergency Medical Services Systems (MIEMSS) is published by Maryland Institute for Emergency Medical Services Systems (MIEMSS). CHATS displays hospital and county emergency-service status, including red and yellow alerts. Its stated coverage is Maryland, United States; status refreshed every 60 seconds. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. The portal describes a viewer backed by an internal database; bulk data access was not established. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
